intent: Deliver a reproducible Round 4 validation evidence packet for the 120 V power stage: a current-limited 270-case tank model, six-corner reference-inductance ZVS and conditional dead-time loss analysis, and an honest diagnostic replay of the 724 V event. The field-solved board matrix is blocked by extraction defects, so dependent C1/D2 grid and physical acceptance remain open; no board, firmware, component, or held shunt-protection change is authorized.

findings.title: C2 can self-pin a mismatched C1 waveform

triage_groups.title: C2 input integrity
triage_groups.context: Catalog and comparison can accept substituted or incomplete inputs.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Bind C1 raw hashes before catalog construction, then require the full A case/corner pair set.
triage_groups.why: The reported comparison must use the frozen intended inputs.

triage_groups.title: Replay cache identity
triage_groups.context: Cached results can survive changed inputs or interrupted compression.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Bind each completion marker to all inputs, finalize gzip atomically, and test stale/interrupted replay.
triage_groups.why: Resumed runs must reject mismatched or incomplete results.

requirements.requirement: A: two-ceiling 135-case current-limited operating grid, 60 kHz unresolved labeling, switching events, R5 and trip-band screen
requirements.note: 270 two-ceiling cases, derated events, shunt and trip screens are present; safety qualification remains separate.

requirements.requirement: D1: coupled board power/gate extraction with FastHenry fixtures, copper geometry, two-mesh convergence, 1/10/30 MHz matrix; blocked status permitted by master §2.9
requirements.note: Native copper and solver fixtures are documented; the field-solved matrix is explicitly blocked by failed extraction acceptance, as the master stop rule permits.

requirements.requirement: D2: faithful legacy 724 V replay, current/waveform causality, counterfactuals; board-matrix grid remains dependent on D1
requirements.note: Legacy diagnostic replay and counterfactuals are present; extracted-matrix board grid waits on D1.

requirements.requirement: C1: six dead-time corners across bus/direction with threshold brackets and sensitivity; board-matrix rerun dependent on D1
requirements.note: Reference-inductance thresholds and sensitivity are present; board-matrix rerun waits on D1.

requirements.requirement: C2: paired 39/51 kΩ loss comparison at all A cases and corners, physical-model assumptions and conditional recommendation
requirements.note: The paired conditional comparison exists, but findings #1 and #3 weaken input identity and complete-case verification.

requirements.requirement: Every item: frozen inputs, raw-output provenance, reproducible scripts, result README with evidence class and limitations; master §5 status truthful
requirements.note: Reports and master status state limits; final raw verification receipt is missing after five source additions, and cache/provenance findings remain.

learnings.note: Committed summaries alone are not clean-machine replayable without the ignored raw handback; findings #1, #2, #4 and #5 identify source-binding gaps.

residual_risks: D1 remains BLOCKED without an accepted board inductance matrix or SPICE include; dependent C1 and D2 board-grid qualification cannot be made.
C2 covers about 77% of A events with reference inductance and typical/cold device curves; the conditional subtotal cannot approve hot total loss or a 51 kΩ hardware change.
testing_gaps: D1 two-mesh, 1/10/30 MHz, crop, passivity, and package-separation qualifications remain unperformed.
C1 audit checks row count and bracket widths but not the full Cartesian timing/bus/direction/L grid or endpoint fail/pass signs.
QUALITY.md says 12,011-file raw verification preceded five source additions; the final 12,016-file manifest lacks a recorded verifier receipt.

coverage.peer_coverage: Cross-model adversarial pass was not run because the user selected Sol-only agents; an in-process Sol adversarial reviewer completed.
coverage_notes: Three governing instruction files (root AGENTS.md, root CLAUDE.md, zapote/AGENTS.md) were mapped to all changed paths; no CODING_STANDARDS.md exists.
No untracked files were excluded from the frozen staged review.
D1 board matrix was explicitly blocked, so physical board-grid acceptance and dependent C1/D2 reruns were not in this packet.
Reviewers excluded their own implementation areas when reused from earlier worker tasks.
Generated event CSV and raw manifest were reviewed through scripts, summaries, hashes and bounded representative checks, not a manual read of every row.
coverage.validation_note: All six verdicts landed in one batch. Findings #1, #2, #4, #5 and #6 are code-permitted failures whose incidence was not measured; the validator reproduced #3 with 809 pairs and a PASS message.
